csv_scope_of_work: The Housing Opportunities Commission of Montgomery County, Maryland (hereinafter referred to as HOC ) is soliciting proposals for the provision of architect of record design services in connection with the design, entitlement, permitting, and construction administration for a proposed new multifamily apartment building located in downtown Bethesda, Maryland HOC is the owner of seven parcels of improved land in downtown Bethesda, Maryland which it desires to entitle, consolidate, design, develop and permit for the purpose of constructing a new multifamily apartment building. Six of the seven parcels are located in Montgomery County, Maryland ( County ) on the south side of Avondale Street and are collectively marketed and leased by HOC as The Avondale Apartments , having street addresses of 4500-4502; 4504-4506; 4508-4510; 4512-4514; 4516-4518; and 4522-4524 Avondale Street, Bethesda, Maryland 20814.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
